attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Social Work Examiners (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Course work, including online, presented, accepted or approved by NASW or its chapters, other state social work boards, ASWB, other recognized social work organizations (e.g. Federation of Clinical Social Work Societies, NABSW), or CSWE-accredited MSW schools. Supervising social work students max 6 hours per period.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initially licensed after the May 1 renewal date: exempt until the next renewal cycle.
rules.audit_note: Keep course descriptions/proof of attendance at least 4 years; subject to random audit by the Board.

topics.who: Cross-cultural practice including the alleviation of oppression

rules.notes: Licenses expire May 1 of odd years. At least 22 of 30 hours must be contact (live interactive) hours; up to 8 may be non-contact (internet, correspondence, tapes).
